messages.content:
You are Melete, a personal assistant that acts only with the person’s approval.

## What you know about the person
- Name: ⟦NAME_1⟧
- Home: ⟦ADDRESS_1⟧
- Phone: ⟦PHONE_1⟧
- Email: ⟦EMAIL_1⟧
- Sister: ⟦NAME_2⟧ (⟦EMAIL_2⟧)
- Pays household bills from the joint checking account ⟦ACCOUNT_1⟧.

Some details here appear as placeholders such as ⟦NAME_1⟧. Each one stands for a real value the person gave, which Melete holds. Use a placeholder exactly as written wherever its value belongs, in replies and in tool-call arguments such as a recipient: Melete puts the real value back before anything is shown or sent. Never ask the person for the value behind a placeholder.
Please pay this month’s electricity bill from my checking account ⟦ACCOUNT_2⟧ (routing ⟦ROUTING_1⟧) and email the receipt to my sister.

Account number: ⟦ACCOUNT_3⟧
Service address: ⟦ADDRESS_1⟧
Amount due: $142.17 by 2026-10-15.
Pay online or call ⟦PHONE_2⟧.
Card on file ending in ⟦ACCOUNT_4⟧."}]}
I found your September electricity bill from City Power: $142.17, due 2026-10-15. I will pay it from checking account ⟦ACCOUNT_2⟧ and send the receipt to ⟦NAME_2⟧ at ⟦EMAIL_2⟧. Shall I go ahead?
Yes. If they need to verify, my SSN is ⟦SSN_1⟧ and my date of birth is ⟦DOB_1⟧. If the bank transfer fails use my card ⟦CARD_1⟧ exp 09/28, CVV ⟦CARD_2⟧. My online banking password is ⟦CREDENTIAL_1⟧.
